image_description: A close-up, high-resolution shot of a golden-brown bagel topped with poppy seeds. The bagel exhibits a glossy, shiny crust characteristic of boiling before baking. The toroidal shape is clearly visible, though the central hole is partially obscured by the angle and foreground elements. Another bagel is visible in the blurred background, suggesting a batch or pile.
